datasets.name: p1_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_360) AS total_hcps,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_360 WHERE hcp_tier IN ('Tier 1 - KOL','Tier 2 - High') AND days_since_last_msl <= 90) AS priority_engaged,
  (SELECT round(count(CASE WHEN days_since_last_msl <= 90 THEN 1 END)*1.0/count(*),3) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_360) AS reach_pct,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM _sa701.moe.msl_interactions WHERE interaction_date >= date_trunc('MONTH', current_date())) AS interactions_this_month,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_medical_information_requests) AS inquiries_received,
  (SELECT round(avg(response_time_days),1) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_medical_information_requests WHERE response_status='Closed') AS avg_response_days,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_medical_information_requests WHERE response_status='Open') AS open_inquiries,
  (SELECT sum(follow_ups_requested) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_360) AS open_followups,
  (SELECT count(distinct topic_category) FROM _sa701.moe.silver_msl_extracted) AS topics_identified,
  (SELECT count(distinct hcp_id) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_medical_topic_interest WHERE mentions_current_30d > mentions_prior_30d AND mentions_current_30d > 0) AS hcps_emerging_interest

datasets.name: p1_trend
queryLines:
SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', interaction_date) AS month, count(*) AS interactions
FROM _sa701.moe.msl_interactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: p1_reach
queryLines:
SELECT territory, count(*) AS total_hcps,
  count(CASE WHEN days_since_last_msl <= 90 THEN 1 END) AS engaged_hcps,
  round(count(CASE WHEN days_since_last_msl <= 90 THEN 1 END)*1.0/count(*),2) AS reach_rate
FROM _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_360 GROUP BY territory ORDER BY total_hcps DESC

datasets.name: p1_channel
queryLines: SELECT channel, count(*) AS interactions FROM _sa701.moe.msl_interactions GROUP BY channel ORDER BY interactions DESC

datasets.name: p1_specialty
queryLines:
SELECT specialty, count(*) AS hcps, round(avg(engagement_score),1) AS avg_engagement
FROM _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_360 GROUP BY specialty ORDER BY hcps DESC

datasets.name: p1_topics
queryLines: SELECT topic_category, count(*) AS mentions FROM _sa701.moe.silver_msl_extracted GROUP BY topic_category ORDER BY mentions DESC

datasets.name: p2_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  round(avg(msl_interactions),1) AS avg_frequency,
  round(avg(days_since_last_msl),0) AS avg_recency_days,
  round(avg(avg_msl_duration_min),1) AS avg_duration,
  count(CASE WHEN channels_used >= 2 THEN 1 END) AS cross_channel_hcps,
  count(CASE WHEN under_engaged_priority THEN 1 END) AS under_engaged_priority
FROM _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_360

datasets.name: p2_segmentation
queryLines:
SELECT engagement_segment, count(*) AS hcps, round(avg(influence_score),0) AS avg_influence, round(avg(engagement_score),0) AS avg_engagement
FROM _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_priority GROUP BY engagement_segment ORDER BY hcps DESC

datasets.name: p2_channelpref
queryLines:
SELECT engagement_segment, preferred_engagement_channel, count(*) AS hcps
FROM _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_priority p JOIN _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_360 h USING (hcp_id)
GROUP BY engagement_segment, preferred_engagement_channel ORDER BY hcps DESC

datasets.name: p2_coverage
queryLines:
SELECT territory, total_hcps, engaged_90d, reach_rate, under_engaged_priority_hcps
FROM _sa701.moe.gold_territory_opportunity ORDER BY total_hcps DESC

datasets.name: p2_hcpdetail
queryLines:
SELECT hcp_name, specialty, territory, hcp_tier, influence_score, engagement_score, days_since_last_msl, top_scientific_topic
FROM _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_360 ORDER BY influence_score DESC LIMIT 60

datasets.name: p3_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(distinct topic_category) FROM _sa701.moe.silver_msl_extracted WHERE interaction_date >= date_add(current_date(),-30)) AS topics_this_month,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_medical_information_requests WHERE response_status='Open') AS unanswered_inquiries,
  (SELECT round(avg(response_time_days),1) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_medical_information_requests WHERE response_status='Closed') AS avg_fulfill_days,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM _sa701.moe.silver_msl_extracted WHERE competitor_mentioned IS NOT NULL AND competitor_mentioned <> 'None') AS competitor_mentions,
  (SELECT round(count(CASE WHEN sentiment='Positive' THEN 1 END)*1.0/count(*),3) FROM _sa701.moe.silver_msl_extracted) AS positive_sentiment_pct

datasets.name: p3_topictrend
queryLines:
SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', interaction_date) AS month, topic_category, count(*) AS mentions
FROM _sa701.moe.silver_msl_extracted
WHERE topic_category IN ('Biomarker & Patient Selection','Safety / ILD Management','Sequencing & Combinations','Real-World Evidence','CNS / Brain Metastases')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: p3_evidence
queryLines:
SELECT CASE WHEN evidence_type_requested IN ('Real-world evidence','RWE') THEN 'Real-World Evidence'
            WHEN evidence_type_requested ILIKE '%safety%' THEN 'Safety'
            WHEN evidence_type_requested ILIKE '%efficacy%' THEN 'Efficacy'
            WHEN evidence_type_requested ILIKE '%dosing%' THEN 'Dosing'
            WHEN evidence_type_requested ILIKE '%selection%' OR evidence_type_requested ILIKE '%biomarker%' THEN 'Patient Selection'
            WHEN evidence_type_requested ILIKE '%long-term%' OR evidence_type_requested ILIKE '%outcome%' THEN 'Long-term Outcomes'
            WHEN evidence_type_requested ILIKE '%comparative%' OR evidence_type_requested ILIKE '%head-to-head%' THEN 'Comparative Evidence'
            WHEN evidence_type_requested ILIKE '%trial%' OR evidence_type_requested ILIKE '%publication%' THEN 'Clinical Data'
            ELSE 'Other' END AS evidence_type,
  count(*) AS requests
FROM _sa701.moe.silver_msl_extracted GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY requests DESC

datasets.name: p3_inquiry_ind
queryLines: SELECT indication, count(*) AS inquiries FROM _sa701.moe.gold_medical_information_requests GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY inquiries DESC

datasets.name: p3_emerging
queryLines:
SELECT topic_category, sum(mentions_current_30d) AS current_30d, sum(mentions_prior_30d) AS prior_30d,
  sum(mentions_current_30d) - sum(mentions_prior_30d) AS growth
FROM _sa701.moe.gold_medical_topic_interest GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY growth DESC

datasets.name: p3_sentiment
queryLines: SELECT sentiment, count(*) AS interactions FROM _sa701.moe.silver_msl_extracted GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY interactions DESC

datasets.name: p4_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_next_best_engagement) AS recommended_followups,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_next_best_engagement WHERE overdue) AS overdue_followups,
  (SELECT count(distinct hcp_id) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_medical_topic_interest WHERE mentions_current_30d > mentions_prior_30d AND mentions_current_30d>0) AS hcps_new_signals,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_congress_engagement WHERE sessions_attended > 0) AS congress_followup_candidates,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM _sa701.moe.gold_hcp_priority WHERE under_engaged_priority) AS priority_coverage_gap

datasets.name: p4_channeldist
queryLines:
SELECT coalesce(suggested_channel_topic,'Unspecified') AS suggested_channel, count(*) AS recs
FROM _sa701.moe.gold_next_best_engagement GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY recs DESC LIMIT 8

datasets.name: p4_prioritytier
queryLines: SELECT priority_tier, count(*) AS hcps FROM _sa701.moe.gold_next_best_engagement GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY hcps DESC

datasets.name: p4_nbe
queryLines:
SELECT hcp_name, territory, priority_tier, msl_priority_score, trigger, suggested_engagement, topic, recommended_date, review_status
FROM _sa701.moe.gold_next_best_engagement ORDER BY msl_priority_score DESC LIMIT 40

datasets.name: p4_opportunity
queryLines:
SELECT territory, territory_opportunity_score, diagnosed_patients, reach_rate, avg_educational_need
FROM _sa701.moe.gold_territory_opportunity ORDER BY territory_opportunity_score DESC

lines: Unified HCP 360 across MSL, medical inquiries, congress, and digital channels — synthetic demo data (oncology).
Segmentation by influence and engagement, channel preference, and territory coverage.
Segments combine influence score and engagement score into a 2x2 view.
AI-extracted topics, evidence requests, emerging interests and sentiment from MSL notes and inquiries.
Topics and evidence needs are AI-extracted from unstructured MSL notes.
Evidence-based recommendations for MSL follow-up — for human review, based on approved scientific content and consent.
All recommendations require MSL confirmation before action.
